versions.alt: A notice on a classroom notice board about colds

transcript.traditional: 注意！　最近很多同學感冒了　請常常洗手　如果咳嗽，就要戴口罩　如果頭痛，就去看醫生　如果發燒了，就跟老師請假，在家多休息
transcript.simplified: 注意！　最近很多同学感冒了　请常常洗手　如果咳嗽，就要戴口罩　如果头痛，就去看医生　如果发烧了，就跟老师请假，在家多休息
transcript.pinyin: Zhùyì! Zuìjìn hěn duō tóngxué gǎnmào le. Qǐng chángcháng xǐ shǒu. Rúguǒ késòu, jiù yào dài kǒuzhào. Rúguǒ tóu tòng, jiù qù kàn yīshēng. Rúguǒ fāshāo le, jiù gēn lǎoshī qǐngjià, zài jiā duō xiūxí.
transcript.english: Note! Many classmates have colds lately. Please wash your hands often. If you cough, wear a mask. If you have a headache, see a doctor. If you have a fever, ask your teacher for leave and rest at home.

prompt.simplified: 咳嗽的学生要做什么？
prompt.pinyin: Késòu de xuéshēng yào zuò shénme?
prompt.english: What should a student with a cough do?

questions.why: The notice says 如果咳嗽，就要戴口罩: a cough means a mask. Seeing a doctor is for a headache, and asking for leave is for a fever.

versions.alt: A notice on a classroom notice board about colds

transcript.traditional: 注意！　最近很多同學感冒了　請常常洗手　如果咳嗽，就要戴口罩　如果頭痛，就去看醫生　如果發燒了，就跟老師請假，在家多休息
transcript.simplified: 注意！　最近很多同学感冒了　请常常洗手　如果咳嗽，就要戴口罩　如果头痛，就去看医生　如果发烧了，就跟老师请假，在家多休息
transcript.pinyin: Zhùyì! Zuìjìn hěn duō tóngxué gǎnmào le. Qǐng chángcháng xǐ shǒu. Rúguǒ késòu, jiù yào dài kǒuzhào. Rúguǒ tóu tòng, jiù qù kàn yīshēng. Rúguǒ fāshāo le, jiù gēn lǎoshī qǐngjià, zài jiā duō xiūxí.
transcript.english: Note! Many classmates have colds lately. Please wash your hands often. If you cough, wear a mask. If you have a headache, see a doctor. If you have a fever, ask your teacher for leave and rest at home.

choices.traditional: 咳嗽的學生要跟老師請假。
choices.simplified: 咳嗽的学生要跟老师请假。
choices.pinyin: Késòu de xuéshēng yào gēn lǎoshī qǐngjià.
choices.english: Students with a cough should ask the teacher for leave.

choices.traditional: 發燒的學生要在家多休息。
choices.simplified: 发烧的学生要在家多休息。
choices.pinyin: Fāshāo de xuéshēng yào zài jiā duō xiūxí.
choices.english: Students with a fever should rest more at home.

choices.pinyin: Tóu tòng de xuéshēng yào dài kǒuzhào.
choices.english: Students with a headache should wear a mask.

questions.why: The notice says 如果發燒了，就跟老師請假，在家多休息: resting at home is for a fever. A cough needs a mask, not leave, and a headache means seeing a doctor (如果頭痛，就去看醫生), not a mask.

versions.alt: A sign by a hospital door with its opening hours

transcript.traditional: 健康醫院　星期一到星期五　上午 9:00–12:00　下午 2:00–5:00　星期六 上午 9:00–12:00　星期天休息　電話：2345-6789

transcript.pinyin: Jiànkāng Yīyuàn: xīngqíyī dào xīngqíwǔ, shàngwǔ 9:00–12:00, xiàwǔ 2:00–5:00; xīngqíliù shàngwǔ 9:00–12:00; xīngqítiān xiūxí; diànhuà: 2345-6789
transcript.english: Jiankang Hospital: Monday to Friday, 9:00 a.m.–12:00 noon and 2:00–5:00 p.m.; Saturday 9:00 a.m.–12:00 noon; closed on Sunday; phone: 2345-6789

prompt.traditional: 哪一個是對的？
prompt.simplified: 哪一个是对的？
prompt.pinyin: Nǎ yí ge shì duì de?
prompt.english: Which one is true?

choices.traditional: 星期六下午可以去看醫生。
choices.simplified: 星期六下午可以去看医生。
choices.pinyin: Xīngqíliù xiàwǔ kěyǐ qù kàn yīshēng.
choices.english: You can see a doctor on Saturday afternoon.

choices.traditional: 星期五下午可以去看醫生。
choices.simplified: 星期五下午可以去看医生。
choices.pinyin: Xīngqíwǔ xiàwǔ kěyǐ qù kàn yīshēng.
choices.english: You can see a doctor on Friday afternoon.

choices.traditional: 星期天上午可以去看醫生。
choices.simplified: 星期天上午可以去看医生。
choices.pinyin: Xīngqítiān shàngwǔ kěyǐ qù kàn yīshēng.
choices.english: You can see a doctor on Sunday morning.

questions.why: Monday to Friday (星期一到星期五) the hospital is open 2:00–5:00 in the afternoon, so Friday afternoon works. On Saturday only the morning is open, and 星期天休息 means it is closed on Sunday.

transcript.english: Jiankang Hospital: Monday to Friday, 9:00 a.m.–12:00 noon and 2:00–5:00 p.m.; Saturday 9:00 a.m.–12:00 noon; closed on Sunday; phone: 2345-6789

prompt.traditional: 星期六幾點可以去看醫生？
prompt.simplified: 星期六几点可以去看医生？
prompt.pinyin: Xīngqíliù jǐ diǎn kěyǐ qù kàn yīshēng?
prompt.english: On Saturday, at what time can you see a doctor?

questions.why: On Saturday the sign shows only 上午 9:00–12:00, so ten in the morning works. The afternoon hours are for Monday to Friday, and it is never open in the evening.

versions.alt: A clinic waiting room: a worried mother holds her small son, who holds his belly; a young man in a face mask and glasses stands away from the desk, bent a little forward, coughing (small cough lines at his mask) with one hand flat on his chest and the other arm at his side, sleeves pushed up, both bare wrists in plain view; a doctor sits at the desk with a glass of water on it. Only the young man wears a mask: the mother, the boy and the doctor wear none. Nobody wears a watch.

prompt.traditional: 戴口罩的男生在＿＿。
prompt.simplified: 戴口罩的男生在＿＿。

answer.pinyin: Dài kǒuzhào de nánshēng zài késòu.
answer.english: The young man in the mask is coughing.

questions.why: 戴口罩的男生 is the young man in the mask, and the picture shows him coughing (咳嗽). The water glass is on the doctor's desk, and nobody is washing their hands.

prompt.traditional: 那個肚子痛的孩子要多休息，明天就＿＿好了。
prompt.simplified: 那个肚子痛的孩子要多休息，明天就＿＿好了。

answer.traditional: 那個肚子痛的孩子要多休息，明天就會好了。
answer.simplified: 那个肚子痛的孩子要多休息，明天就会好了。
answer.pinyin: Nàge dùzi tòng de háizi yào duō xiūxí, míngtiān jiù huì hǎo le.
answer.english: The child with the sore belly needs to rest more. Then he will be well again tomorrow.

questions.why: 明天 points to the future, and 會 means will: 明天就會好了, the boy holding his belly will be well (好了) tomorrow. 在 (in the middle of doing) and 想 (to want) do not fit before 好了 here.

prompt.traditional: 醫生跟那個孩子說：「如果你肚子痛，＿＿要少吃一點。」
prompt.simplified: 医生跟那个孩子说：「如果你肚子痛，＿＿要少吃一点。」

answer.traditional: 醫生跟那個孩子說：「如果你肚子痛，就要少吃一點。」
answer.simplified: 医生跟那个孩子说：「如果你肚子痛，就要少吃一点。」
answer.pinyin: Yīshēng gēn nàge háizi shuō: “Rúguǒ nǐ dùzi tòng, jiù yào shǎo chī yìdiǎn.”
answer.english: The doctor tells the child, “If your belly hurts, you should eat a little less.”

questions.why: 如果 opens the condition and 就 starts the result: 如果……，就……. 所以 goes with 因為, not 如果, and 可是 (but) does not fit the doctor's advice for a sore belly.

versions.alt: A clinic waiting room: a worried mother holds her small son, who holds his belly; a young man in a face mask and glasses stands away from the desk, bent a little forward, coughing (small cough lines at his mask) with one hand flat on his chest and the other arm at his side, sleeves pushed up, both bare wrists in plain view; a doctor sits at the desk with a glass of water on it. Only the young man wears a mask: the mother, the boy and the doctor wear none. Nobody wears a watch.

prompt.traditional: 那個孩子肚子痛，他媽媽很＿＿。
prompt.simplified: 那个孩子肚子痛，他妈妈很＿＿。

answer.traditional: 那個孩子肚子痛，他媽媽很擔心。
answer.simplified: 那个孩子肚子痛，他妈妈很担心。
answer.pinyin: Nàge háizi dùzi tòng, tā māma hěn dānxīn.
answer.english: That child's belly hurts, and his mother is very worried.

questions.why: Her child's belly hurts, so the mother is worried: 很擔心. In the picture she looks worried, not glad (高興), and 舒服 (comfortable) does not fit a mother whose child is sick.

prompt.traditional: 那個男生戴口罩，也戴＿＿。
prompt.simplified: 那个男生戴口罩，也戴＿＿。

answer.traditional: 那個男生戴口罩，也戴眼鏡。
answer.simplified: 那个男生戴口罩，也戴眼镜。
answer.pinyin: Nàge nánshēng dài kǒuzhào, yě dài yǎnjìng.
answer.english: That young man wears a mask and glasses too.

questions.why: He wears glasses (眼鏡), not a watch; 眼睛 looks alike but means eyes.

prompt.traditional: 醫生跟那個咳嗽的男生說：「你要＿＿多喝水。」
prompt.simplified: 医生跟那个咳嗽的男生说：「你要＿＿多喝水。」

answer.traditional: 醫生跟那個咳嗽的男生說：「你要記得多喝水。」
answer.simplified: 医生跟那个咳嗽的男生说：「你要记得多喝水。」
answer.pinyin: Yīshēng gēn nàge késòu de nánshēng shuō: “Nǐ yào jìde duō hē shuǐ.”
answer.english: The doctor tells the coughing young man, “You must remember to drink more water.”

questions.why: 記得 + an action means remember to do it: 要記得多喝水, remember to drink more water. 覺得 (to think) and 告訴 (to tell) cannot come right before an action like this; 告訴 needs a person (告訴你……).

passage.traditional: {1}我發燒了，所以今天不能去上課。我打電話{2}老師請假，媽媽帶我去看醫生。醫生說我要{3}休息，少上網。{4}明天好了，我就會去學校上課。
passage.simplified: {1}我发烧了，所以今天不能去上课。我打电话{2}老师请假，妈妈带我去看医生。医生说我要{3}休息，少上网。{4}明天好了，我就会去学校上课。
passage.pinyin: Yīnwèi wǒ fāshāo le, suǒyǐ jīntiān bù néng qù shàngkè. Wǒ dǎ diànhuà gēn lǎoshī qǐngjià, māma dài wǒ qù kàn yīshēng. Yīshēng shuō wǒ yào duō xiūxí, shǎo shàngwǎng. Rúguǒ míngtiān hǎo le, wǒ jiù huì qù xuéxiào shàngkè.
passage.english: Because I have a fever, I can't go to class today. I call my teacher to ask for leave, and Mom takes me to see a doctor. The doctor says I should rest more and go online less. If I'm better tomorrow, I'll go to school.

questions.why: 所以 (so) in the same sentence needs 因為 (because) before the reason: 因為我發燒了，所以…….
跟 comes before the person you speak to: 跟老師請假, ask the teacher for leave.
多 before a verb gives advice: 多休息 (rest more) pairs with 少上網 (go online less). 少休息 would be wrong advice for a fever.
如果 opens the condition, and 就 starts the result: 如果明天好了，我就會去.

passage.traditional: 我的朋友{1}了，很不舒服。我打電話{2}她說，要多喝水、多休息。她說她明天不{3}來上課。今天下午我想{4}去超市買一些水果，再去她家看她。
passage.simplified: 我的朋友{1}了，很不舒服。我打电话{2}她说，要多喝水、多休息。她说她明天不{3}来上课。今天下午我想{4}去超市买一些水果，再去她家看她。
passage.pinyin: Wǒ de péngyǒu gǎnmào le, hěn bù shūfu. Wǒ dǎ diànhuà gēn tā shuō, yào duō hē shuǐ, duō xiūxí. Tā shuō tā míngtiān bú huì lái shàngkè. Jīntiān xiàwǔ wǒ xiǎng xiān qù chāoshì mǎi yìxiē shuǐguǒ, zài qù tā jiā kàn tā.
passage.english: My friend has caught a cold and doesn't feel well. I called her and told her to drink more water and rest more. She said she won't come to class tomorrow. This afternoon I want to go to the supermarket first to buy some fruit, then go to her home to see her.

questions.why: 了 after the blank and 很不舒服 show she is sick: 感冒了, she has caught a cold. 健康 (healthy) does not fit someone who feels unwell.
跟 comes before the person you speak to: 我打電話跟她說, I called and told her.
不會 means will not: 明天不會來上課, she won't come to class tomorrow.
先 goes with the 再 that follows: 先去超市……，再去她家, first the supermarket, then her home.

text.traditional:
國安：
你發燒了，現在好一點了嗎？老師說明天的功課不多，你先在家多休息，再寫功課吧。明天我會帶蘋果去看你。
元真
text.simplified:
国安：
你发烧了，现在好一点了吗？老师说明天的功课不多，你先在家多休息，再写功课吧。明天我会带苹果去看你。
元真
text.pinyin: Guó'ān: Nǐ fāshāo le, xiànzài hǎo yìdiǎn le ma? Lǎoshī shuō míngtiān de gōngkè bù duō, nǐ xiān zài jiā duō xiūxí, zài xiě gōngkè ba. Míngtiān wǒ huì dài píngguǒ qù kàn nǐ. Yuánzhēn
text.english: Guo'an: You have a fever. Are you a bit better now? The teacher says there isn't much homework for tomorrow. Rest at home first, then do your homework. Tomorrow I'll bring some apples and come to see you. Yuanzhen

prompt.traditional: 元真要國安先做什麼？
prompt.simplified: 元真要国安先做什么？
prompt.pinyin: Yuánzhēn yào Guó'ān xiān zuò shénme?
prompt.english: What does Yuanzhen want Guo'an to do first?

questions.why: 先在家多休息，再寫功課: rest comes first (先), homework after (再). She never tells him to go to class.

text.traditional:
中明：
今天下午我先上書法課，四點下課，再去圖書館找你，我們一起看書吧。
家樂
text.simplified:
中明：
今天下午我先上书法课，四点下课，再去图书馆找你，我们一起看书吧。
家乐
text.pinyin: Zhōngmíng: Jīntiān xiàwǔ wǒ xiān shàng shūfǎ kè, sì diǎn xiàkè, zài qù túshūguǎn zhǎo nǐ, wǒmen yìqǐ kàn shū ba. Jiālè
text.english: Zhongming: This afternoon I have calligraphy class first. It ends at four. Then I will go to the library to find you, and we can study together. Jiale

prompt.traditional: 家樂今天下午先做什麼？
prompt.simplified: 家乐今天下午先做什么？
prompt.pinyin: Jiālè jīntiān xiàwǔ xiān zuò shénme?
prompt.english: What does Jiale do first this afternoon?

questions.why: 我先上書法課……再去圖書館找你: calligraphy class comes first (先); the library and studying together come after (再).
